subject: High-Dose Flu Shots Track With 55% Lower Alzheimer's Risk
script: From Agewell Brief: High-Dose Flu Shots Track With 55% Lower Alzheimer's Risk. Across 200,000 older adults, high-dose influenza vaccination tracked with a markedly steeper drop in later Alzheimer's diagnoses than standard annual shots. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
